explanation: Two free-falling circles with e=1 collide obliquely around steps 65-66 (touching pair with gap 0.025 at step 66). Energy is conserved (~420J) through step 65 then jumps to ~553J at step 66, ~30% gain with no controller work. Likely cause: body-body impulse/positional-correction for elastic, unequal-mass (11.5 vs 1) oblique impact injects energy instead of preserving it.
vision_note: Two blue circles fall together in empty space with no walls or waypoints visible, the upper slightly larger body closing vertically onto the smaller lower body from steps 63 to 65. By step 66 they are touching in a gentle contact with no visible bounce, explosion, penetration or wall interaction.
